items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: There was a guy, an old man Cooper, but he's dead, and there was Charlie Lawson. Oh, yeah, trombone. That's right, Cooper and Charlie Lawson.

ctx.x: Who else was in Charlie Crep's band? Can you remember even just two or three of them? Well, there was...
There was a guy, an old man Cooper, but he's dead, and there was Charlie Lawson. Oh, yeah, trombone. That's right, Cooper and Charlie Lawson.
Did Marge Crep, that's Zutty's single, that's right, did she play piano?
